title: WebSec Shared Memory Row Wrapper
description: A thin wrapper around a within-campaign memory row so it can be published to the cross-campaign store. The `row` is validated against the unchanged `memory` schema; the wrapper only adds the program_key recall filter, an optional visibility scope, and a publish timestamp. Nothing about the memory row's shape changes.

scope.description: visibility rule: 'program' (the default when absent) recalls only for campaigns whose policy derives the same program_key; 'global' recalls for EVERY campaign — prior-knowledge datasets belong to no single program. Changed only via set_scope / `webv2 globalize`, which logs a manifest record.
